title: Plan architecture and technology stack from requirements
goal: Provide a project-local skill that turns reviewed requirements and feature plans into a grounded architecture and technology stack recommendation before implementation begins.
in_scope: Use the reviewed functional and non-functional requirements, MVP summary, feature roadmap, and existing repository structure as decision inputs.
Recommend an architecture and technology stack sized to the requirements, hackathon timeline, team familiarity, deployment constraints, and current project dependencies.
Compare alternatives and tradeoffs when they materially affect the decision; ask targeted follow-up questions when a missing requirement could change the architecture or stack.

Record components, responsibilities, important data flows, deployment/runtime assumptions, technology choices, rationale, and open decisions in ARCHITECTURE.md, following existing documentation conventions when present.
Separate user-confirmed decisions from agent recommendations and unresolved decisions; do not treat a recommendation as confirmed until the user agrees.
Verify recommendations for new or changeable technologies against current authoritative documentation when needed.
Keep the skill focused on planning and documentation; do not implement the proposed architecture or modify product runtime configuration.
out_of_scope: Implementing application code, creating deployment infrastructure, or changing runtime configuration.
Choosing technologies without relating them to the requirements, repository, or project constraints.
acceptance_criteria: The skill is discoverable under .agents/skills/architecture-planning/ and has valid frontmatter and a focused description.
It reads reviewed requirements and the existing repository before proposing architecture or technologies.
It explains how architecture and stack choices address functional and non-functional requirements and the next features in the roadmap.
It considers alternatives and asks focused questions for unresolved decisions that materially affect the recommendation.
It records proposed, confirmed, and open decisions with rationale in ARCHITECTURE.md or the repository's existing equivalent.
It does not implement code or modify product configuration as part of architecture planning.
